test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the founder of the Sunga dynasty, who established his kingdom by killing the last Mauryan emperor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushyamitra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Sunga Dynasty **was established by the **Pushyamitra Sunga** by overthrowing **Maurya dynasty **in **185 BCE.**
 
• **Pushyamitra Sunga** ruled for about** 36** years from **185 BCE to 149 BCE.**
 
• There were** 10 rulers** in the** Sunga dynasty** who in total rulers for** 112** years.
 
• **Patiliputra** is the capital city of the** Sunga Dynasty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
